# Clamp

Limits a number to a range.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Clamp(value, min, max)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number | The number to limit. Null, or a value that is not a number, is a runtime error. |
| `min` | number | The lowest number allowed. When it is greater than max, the call is a runtime error. Null, or a value that is not a number, is a runtime error. |
| `max` | number | The highest number allowed. Null, or a value that is not a number, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. min when value is below min, max when value is above max, and value otherwise; the number chosen is returned as it was given. Never null.

## Example

`Clamp(15, 0, 10)` returns `10`.

`Clamp(5, 0, 10)` returns `5`.
